origin.description: Download a GitLab repository archive and install it with R CMD INSTALL.
origin.usage: install_gitlab(repo, subdir = NULL, auth_token = gitlab_pat(quiet), host = "gitlab.com", dependencies = NA, quiet = FALSE, ...)

arguments.name: repo
arguments.text: username/repo, or a longer specification accepted by parse_git_repo.

arguments.name: auth_token
arguments.text: Private token. The default is GITLAB_PAT when that variable is non-empty. NULL sends no token.

arguments.name: host
arguments.text: GitLab host. The default is gitlab.com.
Further arguments are passed to install.packages. lib is the library directory and is accepted.

origin.details: The project id is read from the commits API, then the archive is downloaded. Dependencies of the package are still required by R CMD INSTALL when dependencies is FALSE.
origin.example: install_gitlab("jimhester/covr", auth_token = NULL, dependencies = FALSE, upgrade = "never", quiet = TRUE, lib = lib)

translation.description: Download a GitLab repository archive and install it with R CMD INSTALL.
translation.usage: install_gitlab(repo, subdir=None, auth_token=None, host='gitlab.com', dependencies=NA, quiet=False, lib=None)

arguments.text: Further arguments are passed to install.packages. lib is the library directory and is accepted.

translation.details: The bundle is downloaded with urllib and installed with R CMD INSTALL into lib. A check uses a fresh temporary library and does not write to ~/R/library. The project id is parsed with json.loads from the GitLab commits API.
translation.example: install_gitlab("jimhester/covr", auth_token=None, dependencies=False, upgrade="never", quiet=True, lib=lib)
